ck: praneyatipika karanananapi karyatvat prtakuktirvyartetyato ruti-nasritya karyakaranasaptO vyakyati– karyaniti ‘poktrtve’ ityatra prakrtyarto poko apyavaharati sukativisayo na sanpavati ata aha– poka iti sviya-taya saksatkara ityarta poka prakrtereva, na purusasya ata ‘purusa sukatukanan poktrtve hetu’ iti katanuktan? iti sankya tatraha– sa hiti ‘na tu prakrti acEtanyat’ iti sesa nanu ‘karyakaranakartrtve hetu prakrti’ ityuktan kartrtvan ca cnanecaprayatnayoka tatkatan prakrterpokasanpava ityata aha prakrtisceti castvarta parinanikaranatvat kartrtvanityupacaryata iti pava slokarte puranasanatinaha– karyeti ‘karanan vitu’ ityutarartenuvartate 21,2
s: प्रमेयदीपिका कारणानामपि कार्यत्वात् पृथगुक्तिर्व्यर्थेत्यतो रूढि-माश्रित्य कार्यकारणशब्दौ व्याख्याति– कार्यमिति ‘भोक्तृत्वे’ इत्यत्र प्रकृत्

pk: praneyadipika ‘yatasca yat iti vaktun’ (13.4) ityuktan tatkeno-cyate? ityata aha– yatasceti iti ‘pratijnatan’ iti sesa ‘anunantanujnata’ iti kascit tadasat OdasinyapraptO ‘Barta’ ‘Bokta’ ityadi viroDaditi Bavena vyacaswe– anunanteti anusabda punararTe kriyavrtisca tadarTa iti jnapanaya dvirukti ‘visesata’ iti trnorTa nirupaka kartavyasyalocaka ‘ya enan veti purusan’ ityatra purusasabdan vyaKyatunupodGatanaha– purusa iti suKaduKa-Boktrtvalingaditi Bava suKaduKanan Boktrtve Boge hetu karteti vyaKyananasrityedanuktan vyaKyanantare tu Bagavanevatra purusa ‘purusa prakrtisTo hi’ iti tu jiva upalaksananetat ‘upadraswa’ iti isvara ukta ityapi draswavyan tata kin? ityata aha– purusaniti yata evanuBavapi prakrtO, ato ‘ya enan veti purusan’ ityatra purusasabdena jivesvarO dvavapi grhyete dvayorapi paranarsasanBavat tarhi dvayordvivacanena Bavyanityata uktan– sahEveti tantrenetyarTa
ck: praneyatipika ‘yatasca yat iti vaktun’ (13.4) ityuktan tatkeno-cyate? ityata aha– yatasceti iti ‘praticnatan’ iti sesa ‘anunantanucnata’ iti kascit tatasat OtasinyapraptO ‘parta’ ‘pokta’ ityati virotatiti pavena vyacaste– anunanteti anusapta punararte kriyavrtisca tatarta iti cnapanaya tvirukti ‘visesata’ iti trnorta nirupaka kartavyasyalocaka ‘ya enan veti purusan’ ityatra purusasaptan vyakyatunupotkatanaha– purusa iti sukatuka-poktrtvalinkatiti pava sukatukanan poktrtve poke hetu karteti vyakyananasrityetanuktan vyakyanantare tu pakavanevatra purusa ‘purusa prakrtisto hi’ iti tu civa upalaksananetat ‘upatrasta’ iti isvara ukta ityapi trastavyan tata kin? ityata aha– purusaniti yata evanupavapi prakrtO, ato ‘ya enan veti purusan’ ityatra purusasaptena civesvarO tvavapi krhyete tvayorapi paranarsasanpavat tarhi tvayortvivacanena pavyanityata uktan– sahEveti tantrenetyarta
s: प्रमेयदीपिका ‘यतश्च यत् इति वक्तुम्’ (१३.४) इत्युक्तम् तत्केनो-च्यते? इत्यत आह– यतश्चेति इति ‘प्रतिज्ञातम्’ इति शेषः ‘अनुमन्ताऽनुज्ञाता’ इति

pk: praneyadipika ‘anye sanKyena yogena’ ityatra ‘kapilatantroktaprakrti-purusavivekajnanan sanKyan’ iti vyaKyanan asat kapilatantrasyavEdikasyatra grahanayogat tasya Bagavadarsane praDanasaDanatvayogaceti Bavena anyaTa vyacaswe– sanKyeneti jnanena paroksajnanena ‘Dyanena’ ityatra ‘Dyanadinan kevalananevesvara-darsanasaDanatvanucyate’ ityanyaTapratitinirasarTanaha–karninaniti drswi ‘prapya’ iti sesa paWakranadarTakranasya praDanyad vyutkranenokti kuta etat? ityata aha– taTa ceti ‘Dyatva’ ityetat ‘jnanyapi’ ityutarenapi sanbadDyate nanu sarvatra sarvasya sanyojane satyeka evayan prakara syat taTaca ‘kecit’ ‘anye’ ‘pare’ ityuktanayuktan syadityata aha– anya iti DyanadavutarotarasaDane saksadasaktananapi tatadupayajnanadipradarsanarTanavasTaBedanasritya ‘anye’ ityadyukta-nityarTa 25,26
ck: praneyatipika ‘anye sankyena yokena’ ityatra ‘kapilatantroktaprakrti-purusavivekacnanan sankyan’ iti vyakyanan asat kapilatantrasyavEtikasyatra krahanayokat tasya pakavatarsane pratanasatanatvayokaceti pavena anyata vyacaste– sankyeneti cnanena paroksacnanena ‘tyanena’ ityatra ‘tyanatinan kevalananevesvara-tarsanasatanatvanucyate’ ityanyatapratitinirasartanaha–karninaniti trsti ‘prapya’ iti sesa patakranatartakranasya pratanyat vyutkranenokti kuta etat? ityata aha– tata ceti ‘tyatva’ ityetat ‘cnanyapi’ ityutarenapi sanpatyate nanu sarvatra sarvasya sanyocane satyeka evayan prakara syat tataca ‘kecit’ ‘anye’ ‘pare’ ityuktanayuktan syatityata aha– anya iti tyanatavutarotarasatane saksatasaktananapi tatatupayacnanatipratarsanartanavastapetanasritya ‘anye’ ityatyukta-nityarta 25,26
s: प्रमेयदीपिका ‘अन्ये साङ्ख्येन योगेन’ इत्यत्र ‘कापिलतन्त्रोक्तप्रकृति-पुरुषविवेकज्ञानं साङ्ख्यम्’ इति व्याख्यानम् असत् कापिलतन्त्रस्यावैदिकस्

pk: praneyadipika ‘tat ksetran yaca’ (gi.13.4) iti pratijnatasya sarvasyoktatvat kinutarenetyata aha– punasceti uktasya punarvacane ko heturityata uktan– sanyaditi isvaraDarnasyoBayaDarnat praDanyena sanyagrahanan tatra prakrtipurusaDarnakaTanan ‘yadrk’ iti pratijnate antarBavati isvaraDarnakaTanan ca ‘yatpraBava’ iti 27-29
ck: praneyatipika ‘tat ksetran yaca’ (ki.13.4) iti praticnatasya sarvasyoktatvat kinutarenetyata aha– punasceti uktasya punarvacane ko heturityata uktan– sanyatiti isvaratarnasyopayatarnat pratanyena sanyakrahanan tatra prakrtipurusatarnakatanan ‘yatrk’ iti praticnate antarpavati isvaratarnakatanan ca ‘yatprapava’ iti 27-29
s: प्रमेयदीपिका ‘तत् क्षेत्रं यच्च’ (गी.१३.४) इति प्रतिज्ञातस्य सर्वस्योक्तत्वात् किमुत्तरेणेत्यत आह– पुनश्चेति उक्तस्य पुनर्वचने को हेतुरित्यत

pk: praneyadipika ‘prakrtyEva ca’ ityatra ‘ya prakrtyEva ca karnani kriyananani pasyati sa atnananakartaran pasyati’ iti kascit anvayanaha tadasat taTasabdavEyarTyapateriti BavenanyaTaha– atnanan ceti sa pasyati paranesvaran 30
ck: praneyatipika ‘prakrtyEva ca’ ityatra ‘ya prakrtyEva ca karnani kriyananani pasyati sa atnananakartaran pasyati’ iti kascit anvayanaha tatasat tatasaptavEyartyapateriti pavenanyataha– atnanan ceti sa pasyati paranesvaran 30
s: प्रमेयदीपिका ‘प्रकृत्यैव च’ इत्यत्र ‘यः प्रकृत्यैव च कर्माणि क्रियमाणानि पश्यति स आत्मानमकर्तारं पश्यति’ इति कश्चित् अन्वयमाह तदसत् तथाशब्दव

pk: praneyadipika ‘ekasTan’ ityasya ‘ekasTatnakan’ iti vyaKyanan sarvaprananavirudDaniti Bavenaha– ekasTaniti ‘tata eva ca vistaran’ ityasya svasnadeva visvasya vistaran’ iti vyaKyananasaditi Bavenaha– tata eveti vistaran utpatin 31
ck: praneyatipika ‘ekastan’ ityasya ‘ekastatnakan’ iti vyakyanan sarvaprananavirutaniti pavenaha– ekastaniti ‘tata eva ca vistaran’ ityasya svasnateva visvasya vistaran’ iti vyakyananasatiti pavenaha– tata eveti vistaran utpatin 31
s: प्रमेयदीपिका ‘एकस्थम्’ इत्यस्य ‘एकस्थात्मकम्’ इति व्याख्यानं सर्वप्रमाणविरुद्धमिति भावेनाऽह– एकस्थमिति ‘तत एव च विस्तारम्’ इत्यस्य स्वस्मादे

pk: praneyadipika ‘avyaya’ ityanuvadena lepaBavanatran viDiyate’ ityanyaTapratitinirasarTanaha– naceti etenavyayatvanapi saDyanapraptatvadityuktan Bavati tasya visno anena ‘jivavisesananetat tasya praptisadBavena pratiseDo-papate’ iti nirastan visnorapi ‘sarirasTopi’ iti prapteruktatvat anadi-nirgunatvayoravyayayatve hetutvanupapadayitun vyaptinaha– saditi yad vyayi tat praya sadi gunatnakan ceti yojana pragaBave vyaBicaravaranaya ‘praya’ ityuktan sadyeva gunatnakanevetyavaDaranena yaTasTitayojana va ‘na karoti nirgunatvat’ itisvarasya kriyagunaBava pratiyata ityata aha– na karotiti purastaduktaneva snarayati– neti ityadivat ‘akriyatvadikan vyaKyeyan’ iti sesa yadyapyavyayatvanapyatra saDyan taTapi talokato jnatun sakyata iti lepaBavanatran ‘yaTa sarvagatan’ ityupapadyate 32
ck: praneyatipika ‘avyaya’ ityanuvatena lepapavanatran vitiyate’ ityanyatapratitinirasartanaha– naceti etenavyayatvanapi satyanapraptatvatityuktan pavati tasya visno anena ‘civavisesananetat tasya praptisatpavena pratiseto-papate’ iti nirastan visnorapi ‘sarirastopi’ iti prapteruktatvat anati-nirkunatvayoravyayayatve hetutvanupapatayitun vyaptinaha– satiti yat vyayi tat praya sati kunatnakan ceti yocana prakapave vyapicaravaranaya ‘praya’ ityuktan satyeva kunatnakanevetyavataranena yatastitayocana va ‘na karoti nirkunatvat’ itisvarasya kriyakunapava pratiyata ityata aha– na karotiti purastatuktaneva snarayati– neti ityativat ‘akriyatvatikan vyakyeyan’ iti sesa yatyapyavyayatvanapyatra satyan tatapi talokato cnatun sakyata iti lepapavanatran ‘yata sarvakatan’ ityupapatyate 32
s: प्रमेयदीपिका ‘अव्ययः’ इत्यनुवादेन लेपाभावमात्रं विधीयते’ इत्यन्यथाप्रतीतिनिरासार्थमाह– नचेति एतेनाव्ययत्वमपि साध्यमप्राप्तत्वादित्युक्तं भवत

pk: praneyadipika ‘Butaprakrtinoksan’ ityasya ‘Butanan prakrtiravidya tasya noksanavasanalaksanan’ iti vyaKyananasat ButasabdavEyarTyat avidyaDvansa-syanuktatvena ‘evan’ iti paranarsayogaceti Bavenaha– ButeBya iti anena ‘Butaprakrti’ iti dvandva tata pancani iti yogaviBagat pancanitatpurusa ityuktan Bavati ButeBya prTivyadiBya nanu nokso na pragukta ityata uktan– noksasaDananiti karane Gan ityarTa noksasaDananapi noktanityata aha– ananitvadikaniti jnanasaDananapi paranparaya noksasaDananiti Bava noksasabdasya nityasapeksatvanasanarTatvan yadva ‘ButeBya prakrtesca’ iti sanasadvayasucanarTan prTageva vakyan tato noksapadavyaKyanan prTageveti 35 iti srinadanandatirTaBagavatpadacaryaviracitasya srinadgitaBasyasya wikayan jayatirTanuniviracitayan praneyadipikayan trayodasoDyaya sanapta 13
ck: praneyatipika ‘putaprakrtinoksan’ ityasya ‘putanan prakrtiravitya tasya noksanavasanalaksanan’ iti vyakyananasat putasaptavEyartyat avityatvansa-syanuktatvena ‘evan’ iti paranarsayokaceti pavenaha– putepya iti anena ‘putaprakrti’ iti tvantva tata pancani iti yokavipakat pancanitatpurusa ityuktan pavati putepya prtivyatipya nanu nokso na prakukta ityata uktan– noksasatananiti karane kan ityarta noksasatananapi noktanityata aha– ananitvatikaniti cnanasatananapi paranparaya noksasatananiti pava noksasaptasya nityasapeksatvanasanartatvan yatva ‘putepya prakrtesca’ iti sanasatvayasucanartan prtakeva vakyan tato noksapatavyakyanan prtakeveti 35 iti srinatanantatirtapakavatpatacaryaviracitasya srinatkitapasyasya tikayan cayatirtanuniviracitayan praneyatipikayan trayotasotyaya sanapta 13
s: प्रमेयदीपिका ‘भूतप्रकृतिमोक्षम्’ इत्यस्य ‘भूतानां प्रकृतिरविद्या तस्याः मोक्षमवसानलक्षणम्’ इति व्याख्यानमसत् भूतशब्दवैयर्थ्यात् अविद्याध्वंस

pk: praneyadipika utaresan pancananaDyayanan pratipadyanaha– saDana-niti ‘yoge tvinan srnu’ (2.39) iti pratijnaya, asasWaparisanapte kana-varjanaditikartavyatasahitan karnaDyanalaksanan jnanasaDananuktan tatretikartavyatansan utarEraDyayE prapancayatityarTa ‘nana yonirnahadbrahna’ (14.3), ‘na tadBasayate surya’ (15.6) ityadinesvaranahatnyasyapi vacanat kaTanetat? ityata uktan– praDanye-neti pracuryapeksaya sangrahakanetadityarTa avantarapratipadyaBedadaDyayaBeda tatra ‘yavatsanjayate kincit’ (13.27) ityuktavivaranapurvakan ‘karanan gunasangosya’ ityuktan gunasanbanDan prapancya tadatyayasaDanan anenaDyayenocyate
ck: praneyatipika utaresan pancananatyayanan pratipatyanaha– satana-niti ‘yoke tvinan srnu’ (2.39) iti praticnaya, asastaparisanapte kana-varcanatitikartavyatasahitan karnatyanalaksanan cnanasatananuktan tatretikartavyatansan utarEratyayE prapancayatityarta ‘nana yonirnahatprahna’ (14.3), ‘na tatpasayate surya’ (15.6) ityatinesvaranahatnyasyapi vacanat katanetat? ityata uktan– pratanye-neti pracuryapeksaya sankrahakanetatityarta avantarapratipatyapetatatyayapeta tatra ‘yavatsancayate kincit’ (13.27) ityuktavivaranapurvakan ‘karanan kunasankosya’ ityuktan kunasanpantan prapancya tatatyayasatanan anenatyayenocyate
s: प्रमेयदीपिका उत्तरेषां पञ्चानामध्यायानां प्रतिपाद्यमाह– साधन-मिति ‘योगे त्विमां शृणु’ (२.३९) इति प्रतिज्ञाय, आषष्ठपरिसमाप्तेः काम-वर्जनादीति

pk: praneyadipika atra ‘nahad brahna’ iti jaqavidyocyate’ iti pratiti-nirasarTanaha– nahaditi prakrti nahalaksni nanu satvan rajastana iti jaqa prakrti vaksyate tatsaniDanadatrapi sEva yukteti cena tatrapi cetanaprakrtyaBi-Danat kaTanasya satvadiBedaBinatvan ? ityata aha– sa ceti jaqaprakrte-raBinanini tatkaryasatvadigunaBinanini etadrupatrayavatityarTa nanu Bagavati ‘nahesvari brahni kOnari nahendri sri Bu durga’ iti saptaDa Bina aganesucyate tatkaTan triDa Binocyate ? ityata aha– uneti adya catasro Bagavatya anya kuta ? jiva kaTan tadrupatvokti ? tadansayuta tatsaniDanopeta kuta etat ? ityata aha– taTa ceti ‘nana yoni’ ityetat pare vyacaksate ‘nana svarupaButa yoni karanan visvasya pratita evanvaye ‘nana nata’ ityapate’ iti tanirasarTanaha– naneti BaryetyarTa ‘nana’ ityanuvadenanyaTapratitavanvayabaDa syaditi sucayati pratita-nvayangikare ‘nata’ ityapi pratiyeta tatra kaTan Baryeti niscaya ityata aha– natviti ‘iti pratiti prasajyate’ iti sesa kuto na ? ityata aha– vakyeti ‘tasnin garBan dadanyahan’ iti vakyasesat BaryarTataniscayat
ck: praneyatipika atra ‘nahat prahna’ iti catavityocyate’ iti pratiti-nirasartanaha– nahatiti prakrti nahalaksni nanu satvan racastana iti cata prakrti vaksyate tatsanitanatatrapi sEva yukteti cena tatrapi cetanaprakrtyapi-tanat katanasya satvatipetapinatvan ? ityata aha– sa ceti cataprakrte-rapinanini tatkaryasatvatikunapinanini etatrupatrayavatityarta nanu pakavati ‘nahesvari prahni kOnari nahentri sri pu turka’ iti saptata pina akanesucyate tatkatan trita pinocyate ? ityata aha– uneti atya catasro pakavatya anya kuta ? civa katan tatrupatvokti ? tatansayuta tatsanitanopeta kuta etat ? ityata aha– tata ceti ‘nana yoni’ ityetat pare vyacaksate ‘nana svarupaputa yoni karanan visvasya pratita evanvaye ‘nana nata’ ityapate’ iti tanirasartanaha– naneti paryetyarta ‘nana’ ityanuvatenanyatapratitavanvayapata syatiti sucayati pratita-nvayankikare ‘nata’ ityapi pratiyeta tatra katan paryeti niscaya ityata aha– natviti ‘iti pratiti prasacyate’ iti sesa kuto na ? ityata aha– vakyeti ‘tasnin karpan tatanyahan’ iti vakyasesat paryartataniscayat
s: प्रमेयदीपिका अत्र ‘महद् ब्रह्म’ इति जडाविद्योच्यते’ इति प्रतीति-निरासार्थमाह– महदिति प्रकृतिः महालक्ष्मीः ननु सत्त्वं रजस्तमः इति जडा प्रकृत

pk: praneyadipika nanu pratijnatan jnanan slokadvayenoktan tatkinutarena granTenaDyayasangatanucyate ? ityata aha– banDeti yo hi badDosniti janati sa eva tanivrtisaDanan vijijnasya jnatva anutisWati ato banDocCeda-saDananusWanaya tajnapanarTan jijnasanutpadayitun gunatrayakrtabanDaprakaran adO tavad darsayati iti nasangatirityarTa 5
ck: praneyatipika nanu praticnatan cnanan slokatvayenoktan tatkinutarena krantenatyayasankatanucyate ? ityata aha– panteti yo hi patosniti canati sa eva tanivrtisatanan vicicnasya cnatva anutistati ato pantoceta-satananustanaya tacnapanartan cicnasanutpatayitun kunatrayakrtapantaprakaran atO tavat tarsayati iti nasankatirityarta 5
s: प्रमेयदीपिका ननु प्रतिज्ञातं ज्ञानं श्लोकद्वयेनोक्तम् तत्किमुत्तरेण ग्रन्थेनाध्यायासङ्गतमुच्यते ? इत्यत आह– बन्धेति यो हि बद्धोऽस्मीति जानात

pk: praneyadipika atra raja ‘trsnasangasanudBavan’ ityasya trsnasangaByan sanudBavo yasya’ ityapavyaKyananiti Bavena vigrahapradarsanapurvakanarTanaha– trsneti sanudBavati asnaditi sanudBavan karanan anyaTa ‘prakrtisanBava’ (14.5) ityuktaviroDat sanudBavasabdenavirBavo vivaksita iti cet taTapi gunakarya-kaTanaprakaranaviroDat 7
ck: praneyatipika atra raca ‘trsnasankasanutpavan’ ityasya trsnasankapyan sanutpavo yasya’ ityapavyakyananiti pavena vikrahapratarsanapurvakanartanaha– trsneti sanutpavati asnatiti sanutpavan karanan anyata ‘prakrtisanpava’ (14.5) ityuktavirotat sanutpavasaptenavirpavo vivaksita iti cet tatapi kunakarya-katanaprakaranavirotat 7
s: प्रमेयदीपिका अत्र रजः ‘तृष्णासङ्गसमुद्भवम्’ इत्यस्य तृष्णासङ्गाभ्यां समुद्भवो यस्य’ इत्यपव्याख्यानमिति भावेन विग्रहप्रदर्शनपूर्वकमर्थमाह– तृ

pk: praneyadipika ‘tanastvajnanajan’ ityasya ‘ajnanajatan’ ityapa-vyaKyan pratyaKyatunaha– ajnananiti etaca ‘anyesvapi drsyate’iti drsi-grahanasanarTyalaByate kuta pratita evarTo na? ityata aha– pranadeti vakyasesejnanasya tanakaryatvavacanadityarTa 8
ck: praneyatipika ‘tanastvacnanacan’ ityasya ‘acnanacatan’ ityapa-vyakyan pratyakyatunaha– acnananiti etaca ‘anyesvapi trsyate’iti trsi-krahanasanartyalapyate kuta pratita evarto na? ityata aha– pranateti vakyasesecnanasya tanakaryatvavacanatityarta 8
s: प्रमेयदीपिका ‘तमस्त्वज्ञानजम्’ इत्यस्य ‘अज्ञानाज्जातम्’ इत्यप-व्याख्यां प्रत्याख्यातुमाह– अज्ञानमिति एतच्च ‘अन्येष्वपि दृश्यते’इति दृशि-ग्रह

pk: praneyadipika ‘duKasabda kevaladuKavaci’ ityanyaTapratiti-nirasayaha– rajasa iti ‘duKasabdenocyate’ iti sesa tatkaTan? ityata uktan– alpeti alpatvat suKasyavivakseti Bava kuta? ityata aha– taTahiti ‘rajasa’ iti pancani natraya iti suKavisesanan stokatnakan suKan duKan cetyarTa tan rajasakarnina kevaladuKarTangikare baDakan caha– anyaTeti atikaswatvat ajnanadapi kaswatvat tatPalakasya rajasa taTaca ‘naDye tiswanti rajasa, ‘aDo gacCanti tanasa’ (14.18) ityadyayuktan syaditi Bava 16
ck: praneyatipika ‘tukasapta kevalatukavaci’ ityanyatapratiti-nirasayaha– racasa iti ‘tukasaptenocyate’ iti sesa tatkatan? ityata uktan– alpeti alpatvat sukasyavivakseti pava kuta? ityata aha– tatahiti ‘racasa’ iti pancani natraya iti sukavisesanan stokatnakan sukan tukan cetyarta tan racasakarnina kevalatukartankikare patakan caha– anyateti atikastatvat acnanatapi kastatvat tatpalakasya racasa tataca ‘natye tistanti racasa, ‘ato kacanti tanasa’ (14.18) ityatyayuktan syatiti pava 16
s: प्रमेयदीपिका ‘दुःखशब्दः केवलदुःखवाची’ इत्यन्यथाप्रतीति-निरासायाह– रजस इति ‘दुःखशब्देनोच्यते’ इति शेषः तत्कथम्? इत्यत उक्तम्– अल्पेति अल्पत्व

pk: praneyadipika ‘nanyan guneBya kartaran’ iti svatantrakartrtvan gunananeva nanyasyetyucyate’ ityapavyaKyananirasarTanaha– parinaniti kuta etat? ityata aha– anyaTeti guneBya anyasya kartrtvaBave noksaDarne ‘paranesvarasya kartrtvanuktan tadviroDasca’ iti vakyasesa 19
ck: praneyatipika ‘nanyan kunepya kartaran’ iti svatantrakartrtvan kunananeva nanyasyetyucyate’ ityapavyakyananirasartanaha– parinaniti kuta etat? ityata aha– anyateti kunepya anyasya kartrtvapave noksatarne ‘paranesvarasya kartrtvanuktan tatvirotasca’ iti vakyasesa 19
s: प्रमेयदीपिका ‘नान्यं गुणेभ्यः कर्तारम्’ इति स्वतन्त्रकर्तृत्वं गुणानामेव नान्यस्येत्युच्यते’ इत्यपव्याख्याननिरासार्थमाह– परिणामीति कुत एतत्?

pk: praneyadipika ‘prakasan ca pravrtin ca’ ityanena gunatitasya sarvaTa satvadigunakaryesu prakasadisu dvesakankse na sta ityucyate’ ityanyaTapratitinirasarTa-naha– praya iti idanuktan Bavati satvadayo guna dviviDa sTula suksnasca tatra sTuleByo lOkika prakasapravrtinoha jayante suksneByastu paranesvaradivisaya tatradyesu gunatitasya dvesakankse prayo na sta na tu sarvaTa prarabDavasat kadacit sanBavat dvitiyesu tvakanksadikan vidyata eveti kuta etat? ityata aha– taTa hiti yadyapi ‘na dveswi’ ityadikanuktan taTapi yadi sutana suksnan tana dEvavasat tan praviswan syat tadasO tat jahyat dvisyat gunatitanan ca suksnasatvasadBave Baratavakyan ca paWati– na hiti yadi deva rsayasca suksnena satvena hina syu tada ‘satvasTa’ iti nocyeran kintu tata tada vEkarika nata prasajyeran tata kin kaTan vEkariko gacCet purusotanan? tesan nokso na syaditi yavat asti ca tesan noksa ata suksnasatvavanta eva ta ityarTa satvika suksnasatvavan ‘sa suksnasatvasanyukta sanyuktastriBiraksarE purusa purusan gacCeniskriya pancavinsaka’ (na.Ba) iti suksnasatvaprakaranat noksarTaniscita noksalaksane purusarTe niscita 2
ck: praneyatipika ‘prakasan ca pravrtin ca’ ityanena kunatitasya sarvata satvatikunakaryesu prakasatisu tvesakankse na sta ityucyate’ ityanyatapratitinirasarta-naha– praya iti itanuktan pavati satvatayo kuna tvivita stula suksnasca tatra stulepyo lOkika prakasapravrtinoha cayante suksnepyastu paranesvarativisaya tatratyesu kunatitasya tvesakankse prayo na sta na tu sarvata praraptavasat katacit sanpavat tvitiyesu tvakanksatikan vityata eveti kuta etat? ityata aha– tata hiti yatyapi ‘na tvesti’ ityatikanuktan tatapi yati sutana suksnan tana tEvavasat tan pravistan syat tatasO tat cahyat tvisyat kunatitanan ca suksnasatvasatpave paratavakyan ca patati– na hiti yati teva rsayasca suksnena satvena hina syu tata ‘satvasta’ iti nocyeran kintu tata tata vEkarika nata prasacyeran tata kin katan vEkariko kacet purusotanan? tesan nokso na syatiti yavat asti ca tesan noksa ata suksnasatvavanta eva ta ityarta satvika suksnasatvavan ‘sa suksnasatvasanyukta sanyuktastripiraksarE purusa purusan kaceniskriya pancavinsaka’ (na.pa) iti suksnasatvaprakaranat noksartaniscita noksalaksane purusarte niscita 2
s: प्रमेयदीपिका ‘प्रकाशं च प्रवृत्तिं च’ इत्यनेन गुणातीतस्य सर्वथा सत्त्वादिगुणकार्येषु प्रकाशादिषु द्वेषाकाङ्क्षे न स्त इत्युच्यते’ इत्यन्यथाप

pk: praneyadipika ‘sanaduKasuKa’ (14.24) ityadina sarvaTa suKadO tulyatvabudDirucyate’ ityanyaTapratitinirasarTanaha– tulyatveti tulyatvavacina sabdasyarTa ityarTa ‘praya sarvan’ (2.5) ityuktarityeti Bava 23-25
ck: praneyatipika ‘sanatukasuka’ (14.24) ityatina sarvata sukatO tulyatvaputirucyate’ ityanyatapratitinirasartanaha– tulyatveti tulyatvavacina saptasyarta ityarta ‘praya sarvan’ (2.5) ityuktarityeti pava 23-25
s: प्रमेयदीपिका ‘समदुःखसुखः’ (१४.२४) इत्यादिना सर्वथा सुखादौ तुल्यत्वबुद्धिरुच्यते’ इत्यन्यथाप्रतीतिनिरासार्थमाह– तुल्यत्वेति तुल्यत्ववाचिनः शब

pk: praneyadipika ‘brahnaBuyaya’ ityasya ‘parabrahnatvaya’ iti vyaKyanan prananavirudDaniti BavenanyaTa vyacaswe– brahnavaditi natra brahnasabdan paran brahna kintu ‘nana yonirnahadbrahna’ (14.3) iti prakrta prakrtireva ‘brahnano hi pratisWahan’ (14.27) ityutaravakyat tadBuyan ca na tadatnyan, kintu tadvadBagavatpriyatvaneva anyasyanyaBavayogaditi Bava tatkin yavat prakrte Bagavatpriyatvan tavadguna-titasya? ityata sapranananaha– na tviti tatkin Buyasabda priyatvavaci ? yenEvan vyaKyayata ityata aha– Buyayeti ‘Buvo Bave’ iti vacanad Bavo Bavanan BuyasabdarTa brahnavad Bava brahnaBuyan ‘vada supi’ iti subantanatrasyopapada-syanuvrte vatyarTasya ca vrtavantarBavat nayuravyansakadivat vatyarTasca priyatvaniti taduktaniti Bava 26
ck: praneyatipika ‘prahnapuyaya’ ityasya ‘paraprahnatvaya’ iti vyakyanan prananavirutaniti pavenanyata vyacaste– prahnavatiti natra prahnasaptan paran prahna kintu ‘nana yonirnahatprahna’ (14.3) iti prakrta prakrtireva ‘prahnano hi pratistahan’ (14.27) ityutaravakyat tatpuyan ca na tatatnyan, kintu tatvatpakavatpriyatvaneva anyasyanyapavayokatiti pava tatkin yavat prakrte pakavatpriyatvan tavatkuna-titasya? ityata sapranananaha– na tviti tatkin puyasapta priyatvavaci ? yenEvan vyakyayata ityata aha– puyayeti ‘puvo pave’ iti vacanat pavo pavanan puyasaptarta prahnavat pava prahnapuyan ‘vata supi’ iti supantanatrasyopapata-syanuvrte vatyartasya ca vrtavantarpavat nayuravyansakativat vatyartasca priyatvaniti tatuktaniti pava 26
s: प्रमेयदीपिका ‘ब्रह्मभूयाय’ इत्यस्य ‘परब्रह्मत्वाय’ इति व्याख्यानं प्रमाणविरुद्धमिति भावेनान्यथा व्याचष्टे– ब्रह्मवदिति नात्र ब्रह्मशब्दं परं

pk: praneyadipika ‘brahnano hi’ ityetat ‘parabrahnano hi’ iti vyacaksate tadasat ‘pratisWahan’ iti vacanat upacarosaviti cena nuKye sanBavati tadupadanayogaditi Bavenaha– brahnana iti nayeti prakrta nahalaksni 27 iti srinadanandatirTaBagavatpadacaryaviracitasya srinadBagavadgitaBasyasya wikayan jayatirTanuniviracitayan praneyadipikayan caturdasoDyaya
ck: praneyatipika ‘prahnano hi’ ityetat ‘paraprahnano hi’ iti vyacaksate tatasat ‘pratistahan’ iti vacanat upacarosaviti cena nukye sanpavati tatupatanayokatiti pavenaha– prahnana iti nayeti prakrta nahalaksni 27 iti srinatanantatirtapakavatpatacaryaviracitasya srinatpakavatkitapasyasya tikayan cayatirtanuniviracitayan praneyatipikayan caturtasotyaya
s: प्रमेयदीपिका ‘ब्रह्मणो हि’ इत्येतत् ‘परब्रह्मणो हि’ इति व्याचक्षते तदसत् ‘प्रतिष्ठाऽहम्’ इति वचनात् उपचारोऽसाविति चेन्न मुख्ये सम्भवति तदुपा

pk: praneyadipika aDyayapratipadyanarTanaha– sansareti sansaratyaneneti sansara prakrtyadikan ksetran purvaDyaye sansarEkadesanan gunananeva vrtan darsitan atra puna sanagran sansarasvarupan pradarsya tadatyayecCanutpadya tatsaDanajijnasun prati praguktan saDanan prapancayati tatprasangadalOkikan Bagavanahinanan ca darsayati anenaDyaye-netyarTa jagadvrksasyorDvanulatvan GawayitunurDvasabdaBiDeyan tavadaha– urDva iti kuta? srOtaprayogadityaha– urDveti adO tavadahan urDvena visnuna pavitra nispaposni tato vajirupasca neta ca vajini surya tatra vasatiti vajinivasu tena vajinivasuna visnuna anrtan prarabDakarnanirnuktasca asni ‘sa tejasi surye sanpana’ iti srute tatasca tenEva savarcasan sapraBan anuBuyanananiti yavat dravinan Danan suKan ca asni ityarTa varcasasabdokarantopyasti ‘brahnahastiByan varcasa’ ityatra yogaviBagat sanasanto va visnuprasangadarsanaya srutisesodaharanan idanin tasya tatra pravrtO ninitanaha– urDva iti unato hyurDva ucyate ato brahnadilokasTatvadilaksana suksnatvadigunayogo va nasrayaniya sarvata sarvasnat prapancat sarvEsca gunE
ck: praneyatipika atyayapratipatyanartanaha– sansareti sansaratyaneneti sansara prakrtyatikan ksetran purvatyaye sansarEkatesanan kunananeva vrtan tarsitan atra puna sanakran sansarasvarupan pratarsya tatatyayecanutpatya tatsatanacicnasun prati prakuktan satanan prapancayati tatprasankatalOkikan pakavanahinanan ca tarsayati anenatyaye-netyarta cakatvrksasyortvanulatvan katayitunurtvasaptapiteyan tavataha– urtva iti kuta? srOtaprayokatityaha– urtveti atO tavatahan urtvena visnuna pavitra nispaposni tato vacirupasca neta ca vacini surya tatra vasatiti vacinivasu tena vacinivasuna visnuna anrtan praraptakarnanirnuktasca asni ‘sa tecasi surye sanpana’ iti srute tatasca tenEva savarcasan saprapan anupuyanananiti yavat travinan tanan sukan ca asni ityarta varcasasaptokarantopyasti ‘prahnahastipyan varcasa’ ityatra yokavipakat sanasanto va visnuprasankatarsanaya srutisesotaharanan itanin tasya tatra pravrtO ninitanaha– urtva iti unato hyurtva ucyate ato prahnatilokastatvatilaksana suksnatvatikunayoko va nasrayaniya sarvata sarvasnat prapancat sarvEsca kunE
s: प्रमेयदीपिका अध्यायप्रतिपाद्यमर्थमाह– संसारेति संसरत्यनेनेति संसारः प्रकृत्यादिकं क्षेत्रम् पूर्वाध्याये संसारैकदेशानां गुणानामेव वृत्तं दर्

pk: praneyadipika ‘aDasca’ ityetad Gawayati– avyaktepiti anena ‘tasya saKa Butani aDasca svapeksayapakrswe sariradO karye ca urDvan cotane karanevyakte ca prasrta suksnarupena santiti vyaKyatan Bavati ‘prasrta itya-nenocyante’ iti sesa ‘aDa pataladurDvan svargadO’ ityadi vyaKyane prakrta-parityagaprakrtaprakriye prasajyete gunasabdasyanekarTatvat gunapravrdDa ityatra vivaksita-narTanaha– gunEriti arvacinanulErhi saKa pravrdDa Bavanti satvadayascarvacina-nulaniti vaksyati visayanan pravalatvan Gawayati– pratitinatreti pratitisanaya-natrasuKahetutvadityarTa vinardanasahatvasanyaditi Bava visaya pravala iti sanbanDa ‘aDasca nulani’ ityatra ‘ragadvesadivasananulani’ iti vyaKyananasat prakranaviroDaditi Bavenaha– nulaniti adipadena jaqajaqaprakrtyo satvadinan ca grahanan tesanapi ‘urDvanulan’ ityatra vivaksitatvat nanu Bagavata kaTan karnanubanDitvan? ityata aha– Bagavanapiti atra karnanubanDitvan nana karnanu-saritvan taca karnasanbanDena Paladatrtvad Bagavatopi yuktanityarTa yadva, karna evanubanDa caranaBavikaranan karnanubanDa tadvatvan karnanubanDitvan tadapi karnanubanDena Paladatrtvat Bagavatopi yujyata iti
ck: praneyatipika ‘atasca’ ityetat katayati– avyaktepiti anena ‘tasya saka putani atasca svapeksayapakrste sariratO karye ca urtvan cotane karanevyakte ca prasrta suksnarupena santiti vyakyatan pavati ‘prasrta itya-nenocyante’ iti sesa ‘ata patalaturtvan svarkatO’ ityati vyakyane prakrta-parityakaprakrtaprakriye prasacyete kunasaptasyanekartatvat kunapravrta ityatra vivaksita-nartanaha– kunEriti arvacinanulErhi saka pravrta pavanti satvatayascarvacina-nulaniti vaksyati visayanan pravalatvan katayati– pratitinatreti pratitisanaya-natrasukahetutvatityarta vinartanasahatvasanyatiti pava visaya pravala iti sanpanta ‘atasca nulani’ ityatra ‘rakatvesativasananulani’ iti vyakyananasat prakranavirotatiti pavenaha– nulaniti atipatena catacataprakrtyo satvatinan ca krahanan tesanapi ‘urtvanulan’ ityatra vivaksitatvat nanu pakavata katan karnanupantitvan? ityata aha– pakavanapiti atra karnanupantitvan nana karnanu-saritvan taca karnasanpantena palatatrtvat pakavatopi yuktanityarta yatva, karna evanupanta caranapavikaranan karnanupanta tatvatvan karnanupantitvan tatapi karnanupantena palatatrtvat pakavatopi yucyata iti
s: प्रमेयदीपिका ‘अधश्च’ इत्येतद् घटयति– अव्यक्तेऽपीति अनेन ‘तस्य शाखा भूतानि अधश्च स्वापेक्षयाऽपकृष्टे शरीरादौ कार्ये च ऊर्ध्वं चोत्तमे कारणेऽव

pk: praneyadipika ‘asya rupan nopalaByate’ ityukte prananabaDa ata uktan– taTeti tatsapeksanityata purayati– yaTeti vikaritvadinetyarTa jagato desakalaByan paricCedasyopalaByananatvat ‘nanta’ ityadyuktanayuktanityata aha– antadiriti ‘sanhartrtvade’ iti sesa atra sanatinaha– tvaniti naDyan sTite karta tasyanupalaByananatve pranananaha–anaditi adyantarahitan ‘asanga eva sastran’ iti vyaKyananasaditi Bavenaha – asangeti asanga sangarahityan tena sahitan jnanan asangasastran daDyodanadivad vrtO sahitya-syantarBavadaprayoga iti Bava pratitarTa kuto netyato jnanasyEva tatra karanatve-nokterityaha– jnaneti ‘Citva’ ityasya ‘sabijanudDrtya’ iti vyaKyananasaditi Bavenaha– Cedasceti castvarTa vinarsa viveka vyaKyanantaraparityagenEvan vyaKyane ko hetu? ityata aha– tatasceti yato vinarsa eva prakrtyade visvasya cCeda na sarvaTodDaranan tata eva tasya ekasya eva idan abanDakan Bavati iti yujyate anyaTa ekena cCede krte sarvanukti syaditi Bava
ck: praneyatipika ‘asya rupan nopalapyate’ ityukte prananapata ata uktan– tateti tatsapeksanityata purayati– yateti vikaritvatinetyarta cakato tesakalapyan paricetasyopalapyananatvat ‘nanta’ ityatyuktanayuktanityata aha– antatiriti ‘sanhartrtvate’ iti sesa atra sanatinaha– tvaniti natyan stite karta tasyanupalapyananatve pranananaha–anatiti atyantarahitan ‘asanka eva sastran’ iti vyakyananasatiti pavenaha – asanketi asanka sankarahityan tena sahitan cnanan asankasastran tatyotanativat vrtO sahitya-syantarpavataprayoka iti pava pratitarta kuto netyato cnanasyEva tatra karanatve-nokterityaha– cnaneti ‘citva’ ityasya ‘sapicanutrtya’ iti vyakyananasatiti pavenaha– cetasceti castvarta vinarsa viveka vyakyanantaraparityakenEvan vyakyane ko hetu? ityata aha– tatasceti yato vinarsa eva prakrtyate visvasya ceta na sarvatotaranan tata eva tasya ekasya eva itan apantakan pavati iti yucyate anyata ekena cete krte sarvanukti syatiti pava
s: प्रमेयदीपिका ‘अस्य रूपं नोपलभ्यते’ इत्युक्ते प्रमाणबाधः अत उक्तम्– तथेति तत्सापेक्षमित्यतः पूरयति– यथेति विकारित्वादिनेत्यर्थः जगतो देशकालाभ

pk: praneyadipika vakyarTasya sanaptatvat ‘taneva cadyan’ iti vyarTa-nityata sangatin sucayanaha– tadarTan ceti vinarsarTan ceti visvavinarsad brahnajnanan Bavatu sa vinarsa eva kaTan syat? ityakanksan tadarTan ityanena sucayati tarhi cicCidisun prati tadupayo viDeya, na tu prapadya iti vacanan sangatanityato ‘vyatyayo bahulan’ iti vacananasrityaha– prapadyeteti kuta? ityata srutisnrti-sanvadadityaha– taceti tadvisvan Citsu aByasalopa iqaBava Candasa cicCidisu cCitsu visvavinarsarTi yad brahna visvasya nulan taneva purusan prapadyeta ityarTa prapatya prasanena narayanena drswa punan pratibudDa visvavinarsaksano Bavet ityarTa itasca purusavyatyayotra vyaKyeya ityaha– cCedaneti ‘atastadupaya-viDananeva sangatan’ iti sesa na kevalanutanapurusotranupayukta kintvayukta-scetyaha– na ceti ‘taneva prapadya ityevan parinargitavyan’ iti sanbanDastvayukta asya parinarganatvaBavat 4
ck: praneyatipika vakyartasya sanaptatvat ‘taneva catyan’ iti vyarta-nityata sankatin sucayanaha– tatartan ceti vinarsartan ceti visvavinarsat prahnacnanan pavatu sa vinarsa eva katan syat? ityakanksan tatartan ityanena sucayati tarhi cicitisun prati tatupayo viteya, na tu prapatya iti vacanan sankatanityato ‘vyatyayo pahulan’ iti vacananasrityaha– prapatyeteti kuta? ityata srutisnrti-sanvatatityaha– taceti tatvisvan citsu apyasalopa itapava cantasa cicitisu citsu visvavinarsarti yat prahna visvasya nulan taneva purusan prapatyeta ityarta prapatya prasanena narayanena trsta punan pratiputa visvavinarsaksano pavet ityarta itasca purusavyatyayotra vyakyeya ityaha– cetaneti ‘atastatupaya-vitananeva sankatan’ iti sesa na kevalanutanapurusotranupayukta kintvayukta-scetyaha– na ceti ‘taneva prapatya ityevan parinarkitavyan’ iti sanpantastvayukta asya parinarkanatvapavat 4
s: प्रमेयदीपिका वाक्यार्थस्य समाप्तत्वात् ‘तमेव चाद्यम्’ इति व्यर्थ-मित्यतः सङ्गतिं सूचयन्नाह– तदर्थं चेति विमर्शार्थं चेति विश्वविमर्शाद् ब्रह

pk: praneyadipika tarhi brahnajnanasaDanan visvavinarsa tatra saDanan ca tatprapatiriti sanastanuktan kinutarena? ityata aha– saDanantaraniti 5
ck: praneyatipika tarhi prahnacnanasatanan visvavinarsa tatra satanan ca tatprapatiriti sanastanuktan kinutarena? ityata aha– satanantaraniti 5
